nodes.statement: ∀ {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] (d R : ℕ), Module.finrank F (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.reedMuller F d R) = Fintype.card (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Monomials F d R)
nodes.proof_route: Represent each exact canonical exponent vector by Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm and its coefficient-one MvPolynomial monomial. The map from canonical indices to exponent Finsupp is injective, so basisMonomials gives linear independence of the polynomial family. Every exponent coordinate is below card F, so its span lies in restrictDegree (card F-1). MvPolynomial.eq_zero_of_eval_eq_zero makes evaluation injective there; a variable-only ULift rename handles Mathlib's equal-universe restriction without restricting F. Map polynomial independence through evalₗ, identify evaluation with exact monomialEval, and apply finrank_span_eq_card to exact reedMuller.
